Practised making 100 with tens numbers and two-digit numbers.
Used number-line jumps from 46 to 50 and from 80 to 100.

end.parentNote: Asha practised partners that make 100 and counting jumps on a number line. Vihaan explained 30 + 70 and 80 + 20 using tens, and counted four jumps from 46 to 50. They mixed up the partner for 65 by making both digits pair to 10; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, use number-line jumps to check 65 + 35 by counting from 65 to 100.
